_comment: National high-school policy resolutions before 2000, 1927-28 through 1998-99. `year` is the season's ending year, matching debate-topics.json (1999-2000 onward lives there). Verbatim text from the3nr.com/high-school-policy-debate-resolutions, cross-checked against nfhs.org/activities/speech-debate/topic-archive.
